title: When the light stays on
hook: Two records are taken under a constant condition.

knows: Animals can respond to cues and conditions.
doesNotKnow: In a toy study, light is held constant. Which activity record is consistent with a continuing daily rhythm?

misconception: The stated evidence implies a different interpretation or a universal conclusion.
objective: In a toy study, light is held constant. Which activity record is consistent with a continuing daily rhythm?

claims.text: In a toy study, light is held constant. Which activity record is consistent with a continuing daily rhythm? The first record has repeated activity peaks under the stipulated constant light. The second stays flat. Repetition under constant conditions is consistent with an internal rhythm, but further controls and more cycles are needed to characterize it.
